project_1_subtitle: Interactive 3D visualization for sustainable wall configurator
project_1_description: Development of a web application in Nuxt.js and TypeScript integrating a Three.js engine for interactive 3D visualization of configured walls. The project allows loading JSON configuration files, dynamically displaying different layers and materials, and offering a smooth user experience to explore and present projects without external modeling software. An enriching R&D project for creating a 2D legend that dynamically adapts to the 3D model.
project_2_description: Complete design of a responsive e-commerce experience, from wireframe to final design. The goal was to practice while creating a demonstration mockup.
project_3_description: Development of a full-stack web application for managing room and equipment inventory through barcode scanning. The application integrates a REST API for retrieving and updating data in real-time, providing a dynamic and responsive interface. Automation of data collection and improved inventory accuracy.
project_4_subtitle: Mobile app for space launch information
project_4_description: Development of a mobile application displaying real-time data on SpaceX launches and missions using their public API. The application allows viewing launch dates, rocket details and mission results, with a smooth and intuitive mobile interface.
